analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction and alleges financial loss of £1,169.91 from three online payments he says he did not make, and has chased the unpaid refund (CH-1).
analysis.summary: [PERSON_1] reports three online card payments of £389.97 each to TechNova Online on 01/11 (23:10, 23:12, 23:15), totalling £1,169.91, which he says he did not make. The card is still in his possession and he has not shared his PIN, passcodes or one-time codes. The card was cancelled, a replacement ordered and online banking password reset. No refund had been credited by 04/11 and the customer has chased. He wants the full amount back. No vulnerability indicators were found and he was asked.

timeline.event: Three online payments of £389.97 each to TechNova Online at 23:10, 23:12 and 23:15 (disputed by customer)
Customer reported the payments by phone; complaint received
Card cancelled, replacement ordered, online banking password reset; customer asked about vulnerability, none identified
Refund not yet credited; customer chased; statement extract saved

analysis.severity_reason: Suspected fraud and financial loss of £1,169.91, which is over £1,000 (CH-6).

vulnerability.suggested_support: None identified. Continue to be alert to any indicators as the case progresses.

analysis.routing_reason: Reported unauthorised card transactions fall under ESC-1 and must go to Fraud & Scams. The FRD-1 next-business-day refund timeframe appears to have passed, so the handover is urgent.
